title: Oil Prices Jump on Iran Demands as Hormuz Talks Stall; WTI Closes at $82
summary: Iran's Foreign Ministry said the U.S. must lift its naval blockade before Tehran would agree to fully reopen the Strait of Hormuz, dashing hopes for an imminent deal brokered via Oman. WTI crude rose about 5% to close near $82/bbl. The strait — conduit for ~20% of global oil supplies — has seen daily transits collapse from ~130 to just 8-15 vessels since the conflict began in late February.
why: 霍尔木兹谈判破裂令油价跳涨约5%，能源成本上行压力再度升温，叠加明日(8/12)CPI数据，对美联储9月政策路径构成双重不确定性；期权卖方需关注能源板块隐含波动率重定价风险。

title: US July Payrolls Fall 23,000 — Miss by 106,000 — September Rate-Hike Odds Slide to 44%
summary: Nonfarm payrolls fell 23,000 in July, far below the +83,000 consensus and the first monthly decline in 2026, led by a 53,000 drop in government jobs. The unemployment rate edged to 4.1%; average hourly earnings slowed to +3.2% YoY, the weakest since May 2021. Markets now see only a 44% chance of a September 25bps hike, down from 67% a week earlier. July CPI is due Wednesday August 12.
why: 延续报道：就业大幅不及预期使Fed加息议题再生变数；7月CPI(明日公布)是下一关键判断点——若通胀仍高，波动率将骤升；若CPI同步降温，则利好大盘及sell put策略维持，港股北水流入预期也将升温。

title: Gold Rallies to $4,400 Futures Open, Highest Since Early June, as Central Banks Pile In
summary: Gold December futures opened at $4,400/oz on Monday August 10, with spot prices around $4,342 — the highest opening since early June — fueled by fading rate-hike expectations after the weak July jobs report and central bank safe-haven demand. Global central banks net-purchased 289 tons in Q2 2026, up 62% YoY. HK gold jewelry stocks (Laopu Gold, Chow Tai Fook, Chow Sang Sang) surged in tandem.
why: 金价创近两月新高，直接利好持仓中老铺黄金(6181.HK)等贵金属相关标的；7月就业疲软令市场降息预期升温是主要驱动；央行持续购金提供中线支撑，黄金方向性判断对covered call执行价选择至关重要。

title: Samsung HBM4 Hits 80% 'Golden Yield,' Targeting 38% HBM Market Share by Year-End
summary: Samsung reached an 80% production yield on HBM4 memory chips — the industry's 'golden yield' for profitability — just six months into mass production and ahead of its own schedule. Samsung is now targeting a 38% HBM market share by year-end and expects HBM4 to account for over 60% of its HBM revenue in H2 2026. Analysts expect Samsung to slightly surpass SK Hynix in HBM volume share in 2027. Separately, SK Hynix labor talks stalled Monday over stock-based bonus disputes.
why: 三星HBM4良率快速提升对SK海力士(7709.HK南方两倍做多ETF)的HBM领导地位构成实质挑战；英伟达Blackwell平台HBM供应商格局或生变，美光HBM定价权亦受影响；SK海力士劳资僵局若升级将进一步加剧供应侧风险，HBM/AI芯片板块波动率升高。

title: CoreWeave (CRWV) Reports Q2 2026 Earnings Today After Close: $2.55B Revenue Expected, 15.5% Options Swing Priced
summary: CoreWeave (CRWV) reports Q2 2026 results after market close today. Consensus expects revenue of $2.55 billion (+111% YoY vs. $1.21B a year ago), with a loss of ~$1.22/share as the AI cloud provider continues aggressive GPU and data-center capex ($31-35B plan for 2026). Key watch items: $99.4B revenue backlog sustainability, margin improvement from Q1 lows, and customer concentration risk. Options imply a 15.5% move in either direction.
why: CoreWeave是AI算力云基础设施核心供应商，其Q2业绩直接验证超大规模算力投资景气度；强劲结果将提振英伟达GPU需求叙事及AI整体板块估值，疲软则引发AI资本开支可持续性质疑，对英伟达及AI关联持仓波动率影响显著。

title: Alibaba Plans Revenue-Sharing for Large Commercial Users of Upcoming Qwen3.8-Max Open-Source AI Model
summary: Alibaba plans to require major commercial users of its upcoming Qwen3.8-Max open-weight model to share a portion of revenue generated from its deployment, Reuters reported. Alibaba would be the first major Chinese AI lab to implement commercial revenue-sharing for an open-weight model. The specific rate is not finalized. The move mirrors Moonshot's Kimi K3 approach (≥$20M annual revenue triggers commercial terms). Qwen3.8-Max release is expected around mid-August.
why: 延续报道：阿里Qwen首次从开源AI引入商业分成，是AI变现路径的重大战略转变；若Qwen3.8-Max引发市场关注，利好阿里云收入预期，提振9988.HK估值重估；关注本月下旬阿里FY2027 Q1财报及通义千问商业化落地进度。

title: 腾讯音乐(TME)今日发布Q2 2026业绩：分析师预期EPS $0.24，营收约13亿美元
summary: 腾讯音乐娱乐集团(TME)于今日(8月11日)美国股市开盘前发布Q2 2026未经审核财务业绩，分析师预期每股盈利$0.24，营收约12.99亿美元。管理层将于北京/香港时间晚7:00举行业绩电话会。TME Q2表现可为明日腾讯控股(0700.HK)Q2财报提供情绪参照。
why: 腾讯音乐是腾讯系旗下独立上市平台，Q2表现可对照腾讯增值服务板块走势；关注AI音乐功能（如曲目创作、歌词生成）的付费转化率及在线音乐订阅用户增长，此为判断腾讯娱乐生态AI变现能力的前导指标。

title: SK Hynix Labor Talks Stall Over Stock-Based Bonus Dispute, Adding Operational Uncertainty
summary: SK Hynix's labor-management negotiations broke down Monday after the company proposed paying annual performance bonuses partly in company stock, which the union rejected as dilution of cash pay. This comes as Samsung's HBM4 yield hits 80%, intensifying competitive pressure on SK Hynix's AI memory dominance.
why: SK海力士劳资谈判破裂若升级为罢工或怠工，将直接威胁HBM4产能稳定性，加重英伟达Blackwell平台供应不确定性；结合三星HBM4竞争双重压力，7709.HK南方两倍做多ETF需关注下行风险，sell put执行价宜保守。
